automodpack.firstConnect.description: Review the default content before downloading.
automodpack.confirm.intro: This server, %s, provides a modpack through AutoModpack.
automodpack.confirm.matchedHonesty: All mod files for this pack were found on Modrinth or CurseForge. Those platforms look for malware, but they can miss some of it. They also cannot see what several mods can do chained together. Files that are not mod files come from the server and are not checked there.
automodpack.confirm.computerRisk: Mods in any Minecraft modpack are just programs that run on your computer. They can change files, steal credentials, or let someone else control your computer. That does not mean that they will.
automodpack.confirm.commands: Review the files before you download. If your launcher has a sandbox, enable it. If you barely know the people who run this server, or you do not trust them, do not download.
automodpack.confirm.unverifiedCount: %s of %s mod files were not found on Modrinth or CurseForge. Only mod files are checked there; every other file comes from the server.
automodpack.confirm.unverifiedExplain: They can be harmless custom mods, edited mods, or malicious mods. AutoModpack cannot tell which.
automodpack.confirm.ack: I understand the risk and trust this server.
automodpack.confirm.ackCountdown: The risk box unlocks in %s seconds.
automodpack.confirm.ackUnlock: Check the risk box to unlock.
automodpack.confirm.leftoverTooltip: Checked keeps these files in the mods folder. Unchecked removes them from the mods folder and keeps a copy on the instance timeline. Applies to: %s
automodpack.validation.identity.purpose: This screen makes sure that you connect to the server that you intend to join.
automodpack.validation.identity.paste: Get the full fingerprint from the server operator. Paste it in the field. If the fingerprint matches, no other computer sits in the middle of this connection.
automodpack.validation.identity.notPack: This screen does not examine the modpack. A matching fingerprint does not mean that the modpack is safe to use.
automodpack.validation.identity.methodHi: This is one method that AutoModpack uses to verify a certificate. Press the ? button to learn more.

automodpack.pinnedMods.title: Pinned client mods
automodpack.pinnedMods.warning: These ids stay in the default mods folder for every pack in this instance. AutoModpack still downloads the pack copy but does not load it. If that breaks a pack, that is on you. Restart the game to apply.
automodpack.pinnedMods.liveTooltip: Keep this live jar and skip loading the pack copy of the same id.
automodpack.pinnedMods.missingTooltip: No jar with this id is in the mods folder, so the pack copy still loads. Remove the id or add the jar.
automodpack.pinnedMods.empty: No jars in the mods folder yet. Type a mod id to pin it for later.

automodpack.storage.title: Client local storage
automodpack.storage.description: Cleanup frees pack-history file data that the instance timeline does not pin.
automodpack.storage.removes: Removes: file data that only older pack generations still name, and data nothing refers to anymore. It does not drop instance timeline snapshots.
automodpack.storage.keeps: Keeps: your active generation and the newest one, every generation's notes, your editable files, and every instance snapshot still on the timeline.
automodpack.storage.compacted: Cleaned on %s: pack history generations older than #%s can no longer be restored on this computer.
automodpack.storage.stateHistoryKept: Instance timeline snapshots keep their bytes until you use Forget older than this on the timeline.
automodpack.storage.verifying: Storage verification is active. You can leave this screen. The operation will continue safely.
automodpack.storage.verificationReceipt: %s of %s referenced objects are available and valid (%s). All required objects are intact.
automodpack.storage.running: Cleanup is active. You can leave this screen. The operation will continue safely.
automodpack.pin.invalid: Invalid pinned address. Paste the complete address provided by the server operator.
automodpack.pin.removeConfirm: Click again to remove the pin
automodpack.pinMismatch.title: Certificate mismatch
automodpack.pinMismatch.happened: The certificate presented by this server does not match the certificate pinned for this address. The connection was stopped.
automodpack.pinMismatch.meaning: This can mean the server certificate was rotated or the server moved to a new address. It can also mean someone is intercepting the connection.
automodpack.pinMismatch.do: Ask the server operator about the change through a channel you trust. If the change is real, they can give you a pinned address to add. To accept the new certificate instead: in the multiplayer menu select this server, press Edit to open the edit screen, press the Certificate pin button twice to remove the pin, and reconnect.
automodpack.pinMismatch.dont: Do not remove the pin just to get past this screen. The pin is what stops an impostor from serving you mods from this address.
automodpack.originChange.title: New server address
automodpack.originChange.installed: The modpack %s is set up from: %s
automodpack.originChange.nowServed: You are joining from %s, which is not on that list.
automodpack.originChange.explain: Servers often move, or run several addresses for one modpack. It can also mean someone is imitating the server. If you did not expect this, refuse and ask the server operator through a channel you trust.
automodpack.originChange.remember: Allowing remembers this address for this modpack. AutoModpack will not ask again.
automodpack.detached.title: Modpack not synced
automodpack.detached.localState: You are playing a locally kept state of %s. You chose not to apply this server's newer modpack, so your current files are kept as they are.
automodpack.detached.risk: The server may expect different files: joining may fail or the game may crash.
automodpack.detached.sameGeneration: The server is on the generation you kept. The files you changed stay exactly as they are, and the server cannot update them until you sync.
automodpack.detached.syncAnytime: You can sync to the server's current modpack at any time.

automodpack.offer.syncAnytime: You can sync to the server's modpack at any time later.

automodpack.stateHistory.broughtBack: Brought back in sync with the pack - the file had been changed or removed locally.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileMana: Only game-directory files can be restored to their original path.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileProt: This is the running AutoModpack itself. Restoring over it could leave the game unable to update.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoredTo: Restored the file to its original path.
automodpack.stateHistory.savedTo: Saved a copy to the recovered folder.
